items.quote: If you have a “Wrong” sales manager…. It can cost you your leads, your team’s motivation, your sales culture...
items.statement: A wrong sales manager can cost leads, team motivation, and sales culture.

items.quote: I asked questions in a way that made him feel like I genuinely wanted to learn from his experience.
items.statement: The author approached the interview to make the candidate feel comfortable.

items.quote: His answer eventually came down to this: Ask the client what they want. Send options on WhatsApp. Follow up.
items.statement: A candidate answered a sales process question with vague responses, indicating lack of competence.

items.quote: Very quickly, the responsibility moved to recruiters.
items.statement: The candidate's view that recruitment is solely a recruiter's responsibility indicated a lack of team-building skills.

items.quote: We did not hire him. And that decision probably saved the company a serious amount of money, time and internal damage.
items.statement: The decision not to hire the candidate likely saved the company money and time.

items.quote: They do not treat sales as a collection of talented individuals.
items.statement: Companies should not treat sales as merely a collection of talented individuals.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing the impacts of hiring the wrong sales manager and interview techniques.
